about: Prototype additive overlay for exact ORS water measurement. It does not replace config/containers.json; each existing ORS container must appear here even when no exact method is approved. visualShowsFills says whether a method's visualAssetRef depicts the fills themselves (five cups leading to a jug, a line to fill to). Only then is the picture the measuring step's whole illustration; otherwise the app draws the sum from the row.
reviewStatus: CODEX Decision - arithmetic checked; clinical, local, phrase, and media review pending

measurementMethods.notes: The marked line is exact for the current 1000 mL sachet volume. Product, clinical, and local review remain required.
Arithmetic is exact. Local review must confirm that the pictured cup is a reliably standardized 200 mL measure.

containers.notes: A nominal 300 mL mug has no exact whole-fill method for a 1000 mL packet. Do not offer a fractional-fill instruction or infer a fill line.

measurementMethods.notes: Arithmetic is exact. Local review must confirm that the supported bottle is reliably 500 mL when filled as pictured.
measurementMethods.visualShowsFillsNote: The picture is one bottle beside a sachet for scale, not the two fills. Until a photograph of two bottles exists the app draws the sum.

measurementMethods.notes: Only a verified visible 1000 mL line is eligible. An unmarked 1500 mL bottle is not an exact measure.
